topic: Dwell time issue and data analysis
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered multiple data requests. Initially, a test dataset for 'Провантажа' was requested using model1-5.

Later, specific facility IDs were provided for analysis covering the 7th to 10th months of 2023. A SQL query was generated and shared for viewing raw seen data from July 2023.

The primary issue discussed was a problem with dwell time on the platform. Links to two different analytics dashboards (one for Atrium, one for Visionet LED) were provided to investigate this issue.
decisions: The analysis will focus on a dwell-time issue observed on the platform.
Specific facility IDs were identified for historical data review.
action_items: Investigate and resolve the reported dwell time problem using provided analytics dashboards.
